notes.title: Princess & Conquest 2025/06 Update!
notes.notes: [p]😎 Much has changed! Much has been fixed! Let's take a look.[/p][p]First of all, [b]NG Candies[/b]! This new currency not only will reward the player for reaching our many endings, but will also make the subsequent playthrough [i]fresh [/i]again, by getting unique rewards for it![/p][p]The Cheat menu, now renamed [b]Rewards menu[/b] (accessible with the Q key or in the pause menu), includes [b]Cheats[/b] (unlockable with our Patreon code OR with NG Candies), [b]Minigame Codes[/b] (to get special costumes by completing the challenges of our secondary projects), and the [b]NG Candies Trading[/b] portal![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/9c990b1e873a8a77bcb0059dd87102d24e816c40.png"][/img][/p][p]That's only the first part of this update! I've taken care of other issues you've pointed out lately! [/p][p]The [b]Traveling NPCs[/b] (Amelie and her elusive friends) used to move around the Kingdom only if the player spent time in the overworld, but that's changed! Skipping hours by resting in Inns or at the Campsite will also allow them to move, following their needs and desires as before. It all feels natural 👌[/p][p]You also get a [i]pretty[/i] accurate [b]Weather Forecast[/b], [i]scripted to be wrong on some occasions[/i], provided you check with the cute paper boy in Clocktown during the morning![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/0f5e41f1510c8b2ecf2c3f7e09fcd60e3e35d98c.png"][/img][/p][h3]And finally[/h3][p][i]khheeheheheheiehiehehehehehehehehe[/i], the first event for [b]Toy Princess[/b] and her [b]Toy Park[/b] appear in [b]Beta[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/d8a3e3c54c0ce0865459d757fcb2a598ae905432.png"][/img][/p][p]This means we're now constantly working to have it completed and delivered to Steam as soon as possible, while we keep working on it and proceed to smite every bug we encounter along the way! She's going to be great, we all love her already, time for some chaos in the Kingdom![/p][p][/p][p][b]Size[/b]: 951.6 MBs[/p][p][/p][h2]Additions and changes:[/h2][list][*][p]New currency added: NG Candies! You will get 5 NG Candies by reaching an ending for the first time (works retroactively too), and 1 NG Candy for any repeated ending reached[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Cheat Menu complete rework! notes.title: Princess & Conquest 2025/01 Update!
notes.notes:
The year has just begun, but I plan to go non-stop for a while! Here are [b]3 new Knights[/b] and some important gameplay changes for every Knight out there!

[h3]Rabi Knight[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/67bd6b955bbaa614ab33d5a359d0e1d4c8c5def8.png[/img]
[h3]Magiknight[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/9cee6b684420673d70a518d844c88f5bb76c99db.png[/img]
[h3]Clockwork Knight[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/8caa2655a9d21564fb6369c9e362b65b505f184f.png[/img]

The [b]Complete Weather rework 🌞☔[/b] is pretty cool too, as I've reworked how daily weather works in Princess & Conquest. Before, it was pretty much randomized every time you left a building, or entered the Kingdom Map; now a daily forecast is calculated at the beginning of the day, and the weather changes accordingly during the day!

On the Beta side, I've got the first [b]5 new Dates[/b] ready, and we're 1-2 events short for the complete [b]Mouse Route[/b]! Those, together with the Toy Reign development are the main focus, and I plan to release them in Stable as they're complete, just like we did for all the other Routes and for Beach Dates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/3b3b7e3d066d0d46c198227bf91cd3c40d517a87.png[/img]

notes.title: Princess & Conquest Chinese version!
notes.notes:
[b]公主与征服的汉化终于出来辣！[/b]后续的中文版本的更新我们会在英文版发布后不久就将进行版本更新。

这个游戏的文本量和脚本复杂程度那是相当的大，所以我们可能有些文本漏翻和错翻，也有可能因为代码没修好导致bug跳出，遇到这种情况你可以上作者的Discord 服务器中报告。（[url=https://discord.gg/princessandconquest]无需赞助任何人都可以加入[/url])

我们欢迎所有新玩家，感谢您的耐心等待，我们希望您在作者创作的这款游戏中找到游戏本应该有的快乐！

[b]要切换语言[/b]：右键你steam的游戏-> 右键属性 -> 在通用那一栏里面有个语言，选成简体中文就可以游玩简中版本。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/e599e44dd2e03ca62b28a2023551b263721223fa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/00edfb98fa5f0ff213213c2aa03acafa44811d6c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/a77fd29d3fc5deb321146bb973776cbf2331f25a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/a7a9ceeec8b731696e4d36f1f3c7b1bf56794528.png[/img]

[b]Princess & Conquest has finally been translated into Chinese![/b] We'll keep supporting this language, releasing updated builds soon after the English ones!

The game is huge, and there is a lot of text, so we may have missed something. If you notice bugs or translation errors make sure to[b] report them in our Discord server [/b]([url=https://discord.gg/princessandconquest]public invite[/url])

We welcome all new players and thank you for your patience, we hope you'll have a great time in the Kingdom, playing our game!

[b]To switch language[/b]: Right mouse click the game on your Steam library -> Properties -> Language

[b]Huge update[/b], cost me weeks of hard work and testing, but changes any playthrough by changing what we've considered untouchable until now: [b]the Knight![/b]

notes.title: P&C Beta Update: 10.03.2022
notes.notes:
[b]This was hard![/b] But I'm so happy with it! Performances have been an issue for a while, I had to get serious!
Tested [b]on the weakest machine[/b] I could get my hands on, and ran around the World Map to see what happens!

[b]🔧OLD CLIENT🔧[/b] Avg FPS: 33.066 - Min FPS: 11 - Max FPS: 44
[b]🔥NEW CLIENT🔥[/b] Avg FPS: 41.369 - Min FPS: 36 - Max FPS: 47

Way less stuttering, and overall better feeling while moving on the Map, even with a lot of battles happening around the Knight!

[b]Size[/b]: 755.5 MBs

[h3]Additions and Changes:[/h3]
ːswirliesː Complete overhaul of the war/siege mechanics and calculations. New routes for armies are possible and adding new Reigns to the war map now take a fraction of the time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896338/82f0b7e26d1aa2075ab6f2fdd05cd70cc013a6db.png[/img]
[i]D-d-double sieges!? In this screenshot Human already control the Skeleton Reign, so they will reach Desert's from both sides![/i]

ːswirliesː The World Maps now have much fewer events running at the same time and there's a substantial performance increase
ːswirliesː Sieges now proceed together with the game's daily clock. At 0 DEFENSE a Reign can resist a siege for around 1 day (1~16 minutes while in the World Map, depending on the Day Lenght you set in your Options). Every additional DEFENSE point will increase that resistance by about 8 hours. This will likely be tuned in the next builds
ːswirliesː Added "Siege Stop/Resume" Cheat
